book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Lazaro Rune
Vaze ꞌahoga, niḡa Lazaroꞌa radiunu. Ani uginiro ebu ezeḡa aheu, Maria zu Mareta teite Betania neḡano radiunu.
Mariaꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro oda rana dehoro hohoḡa manoḡa beꞌunadu iguḡa hina odaḡa zauhiroteꞌe roḡaeḡa. Ani ezeḡa Lazaroꞌe uginiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ezeḡa aheuꞌa vaze ꞌahoga Iesu vaḡe tuḡunadu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡaeꞌa zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ugiḡa.”
Iesuꞌa hari eꞌe egadu ꞌahige rae reiro, “Ugiḡa eꞌe uꞌano, ani mene rudaꞌuma, rehano Badiꞌa ni mae ḡihinoga veize ꞌahiguḡaniꞌa fureraro. Ugi eꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌa Ubuga ni mae ḡihiniꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌe Mareta, negoḡa Maria zu ezeḡa Lazaro zamare borofiro.
Rehano ani Lazaroꞌa uginiroteꞌe hariḡa igirotene, ani aneꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano mada aheu bare radiro.
Eꞌe enogano Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Aroꞌi, Iudea habaꞌa bare onamihi.”
Zeḡeꞌa niro, “Rabi, izidi Iuda azaḡa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa hadi hina ḡamihi raha. Rehano ḡa eꞌe habaꞌa bare onamihi raꞌehe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Oꞌe. Mada tiba zamaḡano agaḡa madaḡa niduꞌaꞌe gaubanana aheu fare. Vazeꞌa agaḡa madaḡano ragavine mene uitiꞌuma, mazaḡa raha ꞌadi agazeꞌeteꞌe agaḡa horoneꞌohe.
U ohore zamaḡano ragavine, ze uitiꞌuma, mazaḡa zeḡe mazao agaḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.”
Aniꞌa ꞌouge reiroteꞌe enogano, bare ziro, “Emeḡe nabudi Lazaroꞌe bazeꞌohe. Rehano e ani vaḡe onamadu evaniꞌuma.”
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ani bazeꞌohe reine, ani manoriꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa Lazaro rune moneo ḡoeriro, rehano ze Iesu ḡoere egadu, “Lazaroꞌe huga bazeꞌohe,” rae zamariro.
Eꞌanoꞌo Iesuꞌa dehene ziro, “Lazaroꞌe rudaneha.
E ani teite mene radiroteꞌe uꞌano, matuꞌeꞌohe. Aꞌe zae veize raꞌohe, mazaḡa eꞌe uꞌano, za eḡe mazao fiꞌuma. Rehano izidi eme ani vaḡe onamihi.”
Ebu Atoa
rae huneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, Tomasiꞌa Iesu tahiꞌa niduꞌa ziro, “Aroꞌi, emeḡe zuni ani teite rudafine onamihi.”
Iesuꞌe Ḡabone ebu Vaze Bare Ḡabozeꞌohe
Iesuꞌa Betania neḡano hanitirotene, Lazaroꞌe amahi idu zamaḡano mada ḡazaḡa radiroteꞌe igiro.
Betania neḡaꞌe Ierusalema uhiḡano, zu faḡaꞌe uḡidu kilomita mene vitinoga.
Eꞌanoꞌo Iuda azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa Mareta zu Maria vaḡe ariro, mazaḡa ezeze rune uꞌano zamaze namizihi reiro.
Maretaꞌe Iesuꞌa areꞌeteꞌe igirotene, Iesu hidoga radu onamiro, u Mariaꞌe neo radiro.
Ebu Maretaꞌa Iesu hidadu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡa ꞌaha reifone, ezeheꞌe mene rudafo.
Rehano e edeḡa, izidi zuni ḡa Badiꞌa mazao nagini umidine aneꞌa ḡaniꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ezeḡoꞌe bare ḡabodiꞌuma.”
Maretaꞌa niro, “E edeḡa, mada ḡonagano vaze niduꞌa runeonoꞌo bare iḡuneꞌeteꞌe madaḡano aniꞌe bare ḡabodiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Eꞌe rune azaḡa bare ḡabozeꞌohe, zu ḡabone ziniꞌohe. Iniu eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe rudaune zuni, bare ḡabodiꞌuma.
Ebu iniu ḡabodeꞌeteꞌe zu eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene hune rudaꞌuma. Ḡa ḡoere ꞌahi mae ḡihineꞌehe?”
Aneꞌa niro, “Oꞌe, Zuhiꞌa Boro, e ḡaꞌe Keriso ebu raha ꞌada ariꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡa, Badiꞌa Ubuga rae mae ḡihineꞌohe.”
Maretaꞌe ꞌouge reiroteꞌe enogano bare ne onamadu negoḡa Maria genaḡa zamahu onamiro ebu niro, “Ihore vazeḡaꞌe emeḡe haba haniteha. Aniꞌe ḡa ḡiaꞌihi raꞌohe.”
Mariaꞌa ani ḡoere igirotene, ḡarihe iḡunadu Iesu vaḡe onamiro.
Iesuꞌe ꞌize zeḡe ne mene diuḡadu Maretaꞌa ani hidiroteꞌe habaꞌano radiunu.
Ne zamaḡano Maria namine radiuꞌeteꞌe Iuda azaḡaꞌe aneꞌa ḡarihe iḡunadu bua onamoga horoniro. Ebu zeḡe zuni ani hegote buaro, mazaḡa ze aniꞌa nianoga veize Lazaro idu onameꞌohe rae zamariro.
Mariaꞌe Iesuꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano feuradu ani horoniro. Ebu Iesu oda babaḡano ḡuḡuradu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡaꞌe ꞌaha reifone, eḡe ezeꞌe mene rudafo.”
Iesuꞌa Maria zu ane teite ariroteꞌe Iuda azaḡaniꞌa niauꞌeteꞌe horonirotene, zamaḡa ariro zu adudaro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “Za Lazaro ahiꞌa nouma tiro?” Ze naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, aradu ḡianoꞌi.”
Hena Iesuꞌa niaro.
ꞌOugadu Iuda azaḡaniꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Ḡianoꞌi, ani Lazaro ufeta zamare borofiro!”
Rehano zeḡe boꞌaḡano nuꞌe ꞌahige reiro, “Aniꞌe ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ubuma raꞌaniro. Rehano Lazaroꞌa mene rudafine ḡau ꞌahoga haḡaogaꞌe mene idararohe?”
Lazaro Bare Ḡaboniro
Iesu zamaꞌe bare borofe areꞌenaꞌa, Lazaro idu onamiro. Iduḡaꞌe hoꞌoga boro zu ibihetaꞌe hadi boro ꞌahoga hina ꞌuiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Hadi ꞌahi mae vaḡinoꞌi.” ꞌOugirotene rune vazeḡa ezeḡa, Maretaꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ani ahiriꞌe mada ḡazaḡa idu zamaḡano radeha, eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌe ufeta ḡezoḡa.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “E ꞌahige ḡaha, 'Ḡa eḡe mazao fine, Badiꞌaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ederiꞌuma.'”
ꞌOugadu ze hadi mae vaḡiniro. Ebu Iesuꞌa adure ḡohani ḡianadu reiro, “Mama, e ḡae mazao manoḡa tauḡi raꞌohe, mazaḡa ḡaeꞌa eḡe ḡoere abitoneha.
E edeḡa, ḡa iḡaiḡa eḡe ḡoere abitoniꞌohe. Rehano ꞌada edauꞌeteꞌe azaḡa veize e ꞌahige raꞌohe. Ze ḡaꞌa e tuḡuhirotaꞌaꞌe mae ḡihinoga urateꞌohe.”
Aneꞌa ꞌouge reiroteꞌe enogano ḡihau huaro, “Lazaro, bua aroꞌi!”
Ebu rune vazeḡa ꞌai bua ariro! ꞌEvoꞌa zu odaḡa ꞌumiroteꞌe dabuaḡa kuiḡa ebu iraḡa ꞌumiroteꞌe dabuaḡaꞌe ꞌize ahiꞌano buaro. Iesuꞌa ziro, “Ani ragavifine dabuaḡa mae vaḡinoꞌi.”
Iesu Manoga veize Ḡoꞌaniro
Ebu Maria vaḡe onamiroteꞌe Iuda azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa nagini haḡairoteꞌe horonadu ani mazao firo.
Rehano zeḡe boꞌaḡano nuꞌe Farisea azaḡa vaḡe onamadu Iesuꞌa nagini haḡairoteꞌe meꞌodoziniro.

ꞌOugadu dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iuda azaḡa boroboro huzadu nu'onu'o boro meiro, ebu ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “Eme nougiꞌuma? Vaze ꞌadi haḡai nu badeḡa ḡehaḡa haḡaeꞌohe.
Eme aniꞌa ꞌahige haḡaoga ḡiane modine, vaze niduꞌa ani mazao fiꞌuma. Ebu Roma azaḡaniꞌa aradu emeḡe haba
zu emeḡe haba azaḡa ruiziꞌuma.”
Ebu zeḡe boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoga, niḡa Kaiafaꞌe eꞌe muriḡano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa reiro. Aneꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe ḡauni ꞌahoga zuni mene edereꞌohe!
Vaze niduꞌa veize vaze tibaniꞌa rudanogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa, ebu Roma azaḡaniꞌa Iuda azaḡa niduꞌa ruizogaꞌe ufeta sauꞌa. Za aꞌe mene zamareꞌehe?”
Ani ane zamaroneonoꞌo mene ꞌouge reiro. Aniꞌe eꞌe muriḡano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡa uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa ihonadu Iesuꞌe Iuda azaḡa niduꞌa veize rudatiteꞌe aneꞌa rae fureniro.
Aꞌe mene Iuda azaḡa veize daꞌo, rehano haba nunu avoavo radiuꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga nuꞌozadu tiburanoga veize rae fureniro.
Eꞌanoꞌo eꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo ze Iesu manoga ibiḡa ḡoꞌaniro.
Eꞌe uꞌano, Iesuꞌe Iuda azaḡa boꞌaḡano hunioꞌe mene ragavinu. Aniꞌe eꞌe habaꞌa modadu haba bohaꞌa uhiḡano ne ꞌahoga, Efaraima onamiro ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite deꞌea radiro.

Ebu Iuda azaḡa Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡaniꞌa hanitirotene, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa neḡaneḡanonoꞌo Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ꞌizema mougano Ierusalema itiro. Mazaḡa ze ibite itadu Iuda azaḡa goro idunaḡano Badiꞌa ubumao ze zeḡeꞌa bare dehezihi reiro.
Ebu ze Iesu vaḡeꞌenaꞌa, kuru neḡa habaꞌano edanadu ḡadimutitiro, “Zaꞌe nouge rae zamareꞌohe? Aniꞌe Mui ꞌahi veize ariꞌuma ga mene?”
Eꞌe madaḡano dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iesu obone tihi radu vaze niduꞌa riḡa ḡoreziro, “Iniuꞌa Iesuꞌe nouma radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederoꞌidene, ihofoꞌi!”
